sloka: क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् ।अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः ।। ६.४१.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: kṣipramadya durādharṣāṁ laṅkāṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।abhiyāma javenaiva sarvato haribhirvṛtāḥ ।। 6.41.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Surrounded on all sides by the vanaras, let us now march swiftly upon the impregnable Lanka ruled by Ravana.
